existingFilesToModify.description: Update CSS variable definitions and add custom utilities for glassmorphism, gold palette, scrollbars, and keyframes.
changes: Replace --background with #050507, --foreground with #F2F2F2.
Add --primary (#F5A623), --primary-hover (#D48A1A), --secondary (#8B5CF6), --secondary-hover (#7C3AED).
Add full --gold-50 through --gold-900 palette.
Update --surface to #0A0A0D, --surface-raised to #131316, --border to rgba(255,255,255,0.08).
Add .glass utility class with backdrop-blur, saturate, background, border, and box-shadow.
Add .shadow-gold and .shadow-gold-lg utilities.
Add .custom-scrollbar utility for thin styled scrollbars.
Add @keyframes fade-in and @keyframes pulse-gold with matching .animate-* classes.

existingFilesToModify.description: Ensure font variables remain compatible. No structural changes required.
Refactor landing page to use new themed components and framer-motion.
changes: Replace hero gradient with theme-spec hero gradient (radial gold).
Wrap Rules items in RulesCard components.
Replace raw <Link> and <button> CTAs with GradientButton components (primary and secondary variants).
Add framer-motion scroll animations to hero text, buttons, and rules grid.
Update all color references to use new CSS variables (gold accents, surfaces, borders).
Update header to use glass utility class.
Replace inline SVG logo with a lucide icon (e.g., 'Swords') or keep existing SVG but recolor to primary.

existingFilesToModify.description: Change from single-column centered layout to a full dashboard grid.
changes: Replace max-w-3xl centered wrapper with max-w-7xl grid layout (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6).
Left column (lg:col-span-8) for GameStatusPanel + ChessboardWrapper + FeeIndicatorOverlay.
Right column (lg:col-span-4) for ControlsCard + MoveHistory + DashboardStats.
Keep sticky header styling consistent with landing page (glass border-b).

existingFilesToModify.description: Integrate new sub-components and adopt dashboard layout.
changes: Restructure render into two-column grid as specified in ChessGame layout.
Add GameStatusPanel at the top of the left column, passing gameId, potSize, currentTurn, etc.
Integrate FeeIndicator as an absolutely positioned overlay inside the board wrapper.
Replace inline move history with MoveHistory component.
Restyle control inputs and buttons using GradientButton and GlassCard utilities.
Update Chessboard square colors to #1E293B (dark) and #CBD5E1 (light).
Add on-piece selection logic (e.g., onPieceClick from react-chessboard) to pre-calculate and display move fees before drop.

existingFilesToModify.description: Update styling to match premium theme and accept new optional props.
changes: Wrap outer container with glass styling.
Update stat cards to use surface-raised and new border color (border-white/[0.06]).
Change pot size text color to text-gold-400.
Add display for moveCount and totalFeesPaid props if provided.
Accept new optional props: moveCount, totalFeesPaid, gameStatus.
